import time
import board
import busio

ADDR = 0x27
BL = 0x08
EN = 0x04
RS = 0x01
i2c = None

print("CP_LCD_BOOT")
try:
    i2c = busio.I2C(board.GP5, board.GP4, frequency=100000)
except Exception as exc:
    print("CP_LCD_I2C_INIT_ERR", exc)

def i2c_write_byte(value, retries=10):
    if i2c is None:
        return False
    payload = bytes((value | BL,))
    for _ in range(retries):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 0.12
        while not i2c.try_lock():
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
        else:
            try:
                i2c.writeto(ADDR, payload)
                return True
            except Exception:
                pass
            finally:
                i2c.unlock()
        time.sleep(0.003)
    return False

def pulse_enable(value):
    ok = i2c_write_byte(value | EN)
    time.sleep(0.00002)
    ok = i2c_write_byte(value & ~EN) and ok
    time.sleep(0.00006)
    return ok

def write4(nibble, rs=False):
    value = (nibble & 0xF0) | (RS if rs else 0)
    return pulse_enable(value)

def write8(value, rs=False):
    ok = write4(value & 0xF0, rs)
    ok = write4((value << 4) & 0xF0, rs) and ok
    return ok

def lcd_cmd(cmd):
    return write8(cmd, rs=False)

def lcd_text(text):
    ok = True
    for ch in text:
        ok = write8(ord(ch), rs=True) and ok
    return ok

def lcd_set_cursor(col, row):
    row_addr = (0x00, 0x40, 0x14, 0x54)
    return lcd_cmd(0x80 | (row_addr[row] + col))

def lcd_init():
    time.sleep(0.02)
    ok = write4(0x30)
    time.sleep(0.005)
    ok = write4(0x30) and ok
    time.sleep(0.001)
    ok = write4(0x30) and ok
    ok = write4(0x20) and ok
    ok = lcd_cmd(0x28) and ok
    ok = lcd_cmd(0x0C) and ok
    ok = lcd_cmd(0x06) and ok
    ok = lcd_cmd(0x01) and ok
    time.sleep(0.003)
    return ok

init_ok = lcd_init()
print("CP_LCD_INIT", 1 if init_ok else 0)

step_ok = lcd_set_cursor(0, 0)
step_ok = lcd_text("CP OK") and step_ok
print("CP_LCD_STEP", 0, "OK", 1 if step_ok else 0)
print("CP_LCD_DONE")
